scope: Shared acceptance policy for all three future comparison configurations
priority_output: NumPy-compatible, same shape as feasible bins, finite real numeric values; reject boolean, complex and object values
evaluation: Every required group and instance must finish; OR3 requires 20 instances and 10000 priority calls
fitness: Require present finite numeric non-boolean fitness and complete group coverage
cleanup: Require worker context, successful exit/protocol identity and verified container removal
invalid_candidate: Record failure, null experimental fitness, no database registration
selection_and_fitness: Original feasible-bin order, first-max np.argmax and negative mean bins objective unchanged for valid candidates
historical_nonfinite_run: Retain as a semantics diagnostic; not eligible experimental data under this policy
